In Mark 12:13 and Matthew 22:16 they join forces to trap Jesus with the question about paying taxes to Caesar. Josephus describes this group as 'those who think the things of Herod' (φρονοῦντας τὰ Ἡρῴδου). The multilingual renderings preserve the Greek form, as this is an ethnic-political designation unique to first-century Judea."
